about.title: Creativity comes before technology
paragraphs: Before I ever picked up a camera, I spent twenty years studying one thing: what makes an audience connect. Records, rehearsals, artists who became hits — and artists who didn't.

For more than two decades I've lived inside the world of music and media. As a journalist, critic and music editor, I learned to listen before I judge — to look for the real moment beneath the production, to find the story hiding between the lines, and to understand what actually stays with an audience after the last note fades.

That habit never left me when I moved into video. If anything, it deepened. When I sit down to direct a music video, a brand film or a commercial, I start in exactly the same place: listening. Understanding the person in front of me, the message they want to carry, and the story that's actually worth telling.

Today I create and direct films and music videos, and the process now includes newer tools like AI. To me, it isn't magic and it isn't the point — it's simply another tool in the kit, the same as a camera, a lens or an editing timeline. What actually decides the result is the story, the emotion and the truth behind them.

In the end, people don't remember which technology you used. They remember how you made them feel. So every project I make starts at the same point my own journey did — with listening. Because a good film doesn't begin with pressing record. It begins with a story worth telling.
about.quote: Technology creates pixels. Story creates emotion.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: Laifer Studio is committed to providing an accessible experience for all visitors, including people with disabilities. The site was built with the aim of complying with the Israeli Standard (IS 5568), Level AA, based on the international WCAG 2.1 guidelines, and with the Israeli Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Regulations (Service Accessibility Adjustments), 2013.

sections.title: Accessibility measures on this site
list: A "Skip to main content" link at the top of every page
Descriptive alt text for meaningful images
Semantic structure and hierarchical headings for screen readers
Full support for "reduce motion" preferences across all animations
Color contrast checked against Level AA
Forms with clear labels and accessible error messages
Visible focus indicators on every interactive element

sections.title: Known limitations
sections.paragraph: Some videos on this site (ambient, dialogue-free visual content) do not yet include captions or a full audio description. We are working to improve this over time.

accessibility.contact: Found an accessibility issue on this site? Please reach out and we'll address it as soon as possible.
accessibility.disclaimer: This statement reflects the effort made while building this site and is not a formal certificate of conformance. For a complete professional review, we recommend consulting a certified accessibility auditor.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy explains what data is collected on laifer.studio ("the site"), operated by Netanel Laifer (a sole proprietor / independent freelancer), how it's used, and what rights you have over it.

sections.title: Information you provide
sections.paragraph: When you submit the contact form or reach out on WhatsApp, you may provide your name, email address, phone number, company or project name, and the content of your message. This information is used solely to get back to you about your project.

sections.title: Information collected automatically
sections.paragraph: The site uses Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity to understand how visitors use it (e.g. pages viewed, time on site, device type), in order to improve the content and experience. These tools use cookies.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.paragraph: On your first visit you'll be asked to accept the use of cookies for analytics. You can block cookies at any time through your browser settings, though this may affect some features of the site.

sections.title: How the information is used
list: Responding to inquiries received through the contact form or WhatsApp
Improving the site and its content based on aggregate usage data
The site is not used for marketing emails and personal details are never sold or passed to third parties for marketing purposes

sections.title: Sharing with service providers
sections.paragraph: The site relies on the following third-party services: Formspree (handles contact-form submissions), Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity (analytics), and Vercel (hosting). Each of these is governed by its own privacy policy, and their servers may be located outside Israel.

sections.title: Data retention
sections.paragraph: Details submitted through the contact form are kept for as long as needed to respond and to follow up on the project, and are not automatically deleted after a fixed period. You may request to review, correct or delete your personal information at any time via the contact details at the bottom of this page.

sections.title: Data security
sections.paragraph: The site runs over an encrypted connection (HTTPS) and reasonable measures are taken to protect submitted information, though no method can guarantee absolute protection against misuse or breach.

sections.title: Policy updates
sections.paragraph: This policy may be updated from time to time. The version published on the site at the time of use is the binding one.

privacy.contact: For questions or requests regarding this policy or your personal information, reach out directly:
